_comment: The USER's Living Wish report (edf_wish_first_keeps_trace has the history) fixed at the PAYER. EDF
seed 1 T3: Aether Hub under two Wild Growths, Conservatory (the board's ONLY white source), Mariposa
as the land drop. The human queues Living Wish THEN Trace of Abundance. Paid one cast at a time, the
Wish took Conservatory and Trace's {R/W} was unpayable, so the viewer could only offer the reversed
order. The whole-turn prepay (BatchPrepayMainCasts) now pays the two casts jointly: Trace's hybrid
pip stays hybrid in the joint bill and the Wild Growths' {G}{G} pay the two {G} pips, so Conservatory's
{W} goes to Trace whichever cast comes first (MTG_PREPAY_COLOURS, 2026-10-27).
WHAT IS PINNED: every surviving variant is the human's own order, `cast: Living Wish, Trace of
Abundance`. CheckLine drops a variant that loses a DECLARED cast before its order preference runs, so a
surviving Wish-first variant is one that casts Trace -- with the historical payer (MTG_PREPAY_COLOURS=0)
every Wish-first variant drops Trace, only Trace-first ones survive, and this fails. The three variants
are Trace's three legal hosts (the choice the human has not yet made).
MTG_UNPRUNED is required (the cast-ORDERING search is gated on it, exactly as the viewer runs).
energy_counters 0: the real line spent Aether Hub's ETB energy on turn 1.
